LESSON: SQUARES AND SQUARE ROOTS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Numbers 1.4 Decimals (6 lessons) • Place value and total value • Multiplicati on
Topic 1.5: Squares and Square Roots

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Squares and Square Roots. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Where do we apply squares and square roots in daily activities?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. determine the squares of whole numbers, fractions and decimals by multiplication in different situations
2. determine the square roots of whole numbers fractions, and decimals of perfect squares in different situations

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

• Today’s maths focus is Squares and Square Roots.

• Start with objects you can touch or draw — stones, sticks, bottle tops, or drawings in your book.

• Say the steps aloud as you work so you do not skip a stage.

• Check your answer with a second method or by estimating.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At the market, count 10 mangoes and put them in 2 groups of 5.

Example 2: In class, count the desks in your row and write the number in figures and in words.

Example 3: If you have 7 shillings and receive 5 more, you have 12 shillings.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Solve three short problems about Squares and Square Roots using drawings.
2. Explain one solution to a partner in your own words.
3. Make up one new word problem set in your county or school.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five practice questions and solve them in your book.
2. Show your working clearly — not only the final answer.
3. Teach a younger learner one idea from this lesson with bottle tops or drawings.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Work out squares of numbers using: o grids and charts o long multiplication method o using calculators
2. Critical thinking and Problem-solving: reflection as the learner uses grid squares and charts to find squares and square roots of numbers.
3. Digital Literacy: interacting with technologies as the learner uses IT devices to work out squares and square roots of numbers. Values
4. Respect: as the learner appreciates each other’s contribution in using grids and charts

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Where do we apply squares and square roots in daily activities?
2. How do we apply squares and square roots in daily activities?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Use objects or drawings when a sum feels hard.
2. Check every answer.
3. Squares and Square Roots is used in real Kenyan life — market, school, and home.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
